```cypher
MATCH (p:Plugin)-[:MAINTAINS]->(m:Maintainer)
WHERE m.display_name = "Your Name" // Reemplaza "Your Name" con el nombre del mantenedor
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[s:SUPPORTS]->(r:MoodleRelease)
WHERE r.release = "3.6"
WITH p, COLLECT(r.release) AS supportedReleases
WHERE NOT "3.6" IN supportedReleases
RETURN p.component, p.name, p.latest_release, p.max_supported_release, p.requires_core
LIMIT 100
```
